transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

My moods have been all over the place lately, and I feel wound up and irritated with everyone at home. It feels like I'm constantly snapping at my husband and daughter over the smallest things, and I just can't seem to relax.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by feeling 'wound up' - are you experiencing any physical symptoms like rapid heartbeat, trembling, or difficulty breathing when you feel this way?

I don't really experience things like a rapid heartbeat, trembling, or trouble breathing. Instead, the "wound up" feeling is more of a constant buzzing energy where I physically can't sit still, combined with a really short temper.
Have you noticed any changes in your interest or pleasure in activities that you normally enjoy, or has your mood been consistently irritable without periods of feeling better?

My mood actually swings wildly—I go from feeling on top of the world like a "super-umma" who can do anything, to suddenly snapping with a hot anger if anyone questions me. I definitely haven't lost interest in activities; in fact, I'm taking on way too much, throwing myself into planning huge holiday meals, church volunteering, and art projects because I feel this intense drive to keep doing more.
Can you estimate how long these mood swings, from feeling on top of the world to irritable, typically last, and do you experience any periods of stability in between?
I'm not really sure how long the individual shifts last or if there are stable periods. Everything has just felt like a blur of being wound up and irritable for the past month.
Can you recall if you've had any periods, even brief, where you felt completely normal or even depressed, without the irritability or excessive energy, over the past month?

No, I haven't had any periods where I felt normal or depressed over the past month. This revved-up, high-energy, and irritable feeling has been completely constant ever since my daughter and grandchild moved back in. I just haven't been able to slow down or feel like my usual self at all.

Have you experienced any depressive episodes in the past, or has your mood always been more on the side of irritability and high energy, and do you think the current situation with your daughter and grandchild moving back in might have triggered this constant state of being 'revved up'?

Yes, this revved-up state definitely started about a month ago when my daughter and grandchild moved back in, which led me to take on extra shifts and all these projects. I don't recall ever having periods of deep depression in the past. This intense high energy and irritability is completely new to me and really seems triggered by this recent stressful situation.

Can you describe if there are any distinct episodes where you switch between feeling extremely high and irritable to perhaps feeling somewhat better or more normal, even if briefly, or has it been a continuous state of high energy and irritability since it started?

It has been a completely continuous, non-stop state of being revved up and irritable for the past month. While my mood swings rapidly between feeling like a "super-umma" on top of the world and feeling hot, intense anger, I haven't had a single break or felt normal or relaxed. It has just been one constant buzz since my daughter moved back in.

Can you clarify if your mood swings between feeling extremely high and irritable happen within the same day, or do these shifts occur over several days, helping me understand the pattern of your mood changes?

I haven't really thought about the exact timing or tracked whether it happens within the same day or over a few days. Everything has just been such a blur, but the feeling of being wound up and easily irritated has been constant lately.

Can you try to think back over the past week and estimate how often your mood shifts from feeling extremely high and energetic to feeling irritable and angry, is it multiple times a day, or does it seem to happen less frequently?

Yes, it actually happens very frequently, often multiple times a day. I can go from feeling like a "super-umma" who is energized and ready to fix everyone's problems, to suddenly snapping and feeling a hot, lingering anger over the smallest comments from my family.

Have you experienced any periods of significantly decreased need for sleep, where you feel rested and ready to go after only a few hours of sleep, during these episodes of high energy and irritability?

Yes, absolutely. I wake up after only a few hours of sleep buzzing with energy, and I physically can't sit still or relax. I'll find myself up at 3 a.m. cleaning the house, rearranging the pantry, or even marinating meat for a big family dinner.

Can you estimate the longest period you've stayed in either the extremely high and energetic mood or the irritable and angry mood without shifting to the other, helping me understand if these episodes last for hours, days, or something else?

I don't stay in just one of those moods for days at a time; instead, I swing back and forth frequently, often within the same day. I will wake up buzzing with positive energy, but once someone annoys me, I quickly shift into a hot, intense anger that lasts for hours. This whole revved-up, shifting cycle has just been constant for the past month.

Can you confirm whether these episodes of high energy and irritability, along with the rapid mood swings, have been persistent for the entire month without any clear periods of remission or normalization of mood, which would help differentiate between a manic episode and a hypomanic episode?

Yes, I can absolutely confirm that. It has been completely constant and non-stop for the entire month since my daughter and grandchild moved back in. There haven't been any breaks or "normal" days where I felt like my old self; it has just been a continuous, intense cycle of being revved-up, busy, and easily irritated.
